description: This file defines a custom Blazor component 'CustomInputSelect' inheriting from 'InputSelect', providing a workaround for input parsing support for integer types in Blazor applications.

classes.name: CustomInputSelect<TValue>
classes.description: A custom Blazor input select component that overrides parsing logic to support integer value types.

methods.name: TryParseValueFromString
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle parsing for integer types specifically, with fallback to base implementation for other types.
